headline: Cards show up again on the new app, and Apply all sends your choices. On some seats the card tool has to be switched on before it can be used; Command Room now switches it on itself instead of posting a plain list.

items.prompt_template: Two fixes. On the new app, and on seats whose chats already run in the cloud, your cards were arriving as plain text with no buttons: the card tool was there but switched off, and Command Room read that as missing. It now switches the tool on first and shows the card. And Apply all on a card sends your choices again instead of dropping them without a word. Nothing changes on the older desktop app.
